_comment: Every role the Nahw page can name, and how each is drawn: `key` is the card's colour key (the contract's, models/analyze.py ROLE_KEYS; null for a role said only inside a unit the diagram draws) and `tone` the bracket diagram's. One table, so a role added once gets both. Read by nahw_book.role_table; a role missing here is left uncoloured. Every role here has a reason in teacher.json (tests/nahw/test_rule_engine.py). `clause_of` on a role: the verb clause hung on a word with that role (or beside it, as the khabar under its governor) is this `job`, standing in this case (u / a / i). `named`: the roles the code itself tests for, by the id it uses (nahw_book.named_roles). `units`, in order: a word whose child wears the `child` role heads a unit labelled `label` (a tarkeeb term), only when the head is a particle if `on_particle`, and is itself called `head_as` inside it, unless its role is one it keeps (`head_keeps`: غير and سوى are named as the مستثنى after إلا would be, the noun after them its مضاف إليه, Tasheel).
_quiet_comment: `quiet_under_job` on a unit: its name is left off when the unit already wears a job (مفعول به, مجرور), so the picture says what the words do, not what they are made of; kept when it has none.
_frames_comment: `frames`: the jobs a governor gives the units under it, as the books draw them. `condition`: a conditional particle, its verb's clause and the answer's clause, both in jazm (case j). `clause_by_family`: the clause on a family's verb by the parser's relation (كان's PRD is its khabar). `masdar`: أن with its verb is one masdar, whose job is read off the relation أن hangs by. `leaf_by_family`: a verb's finer name in the picture ({named}: its family card's name for the word, نعم a فعل جامد لإنشاء المدح); a particle uses its family card's name. `attached`: what a jar-majroor hangs on.

condition._comment: A condition opened by a particle with a verb straight after. `by_family`: for each family whose `conditional_particles` (closed_words.json) holds the particle, its name (`particle`, and `noun` for a family with conditional nouns, and the `places` one stands in: a time or place word's (`adverb`), and that of مَنْ or ما whose verb already has its `object` (`filled`)), the case its two clauses stand in (null: they have no place, لا محل لها) and the letter written onto the answer that ties it to the condition, by that letter.
condition._evidence_comment: The فاء on an answer shows the condition only when the answer could not stand as a condition itself (التسهيل: اقتران جواب الشرط بالفاء): a noun sentence, a particle (إنّ، لا، قد، السين), a command, or a fixed verb (`fixed_verbs`: the families and words of verbs that take no tense). A plain past verb after فاء could stand alone, so it is no evidence for مَنْ or ما, which a relative also shares.
condition._place_comment: Where the two clauses stand: the condition's own clause has no place (جملة الشرط لا محل لها) unless its family gives a `verb_case` (after إذا it is في محل جر, the time word's مضاف إليه); the answer stands in the family's `case` only when a tie letter (فَ) is written onto it, else it too has none. A verb's own jazm is said on its card.

ghair_amila_other._by_word_comment: `by_word`: a member whose condition differs from its family's, laid over it. لولا and لوما (حرف امتناع لوجود) open a condition before a noun, not a verb (`before`): that noun is a مبتدأ (`subject`) whose khabar is left out, always (`subject_said`), and the answer is جواب لولا. Before a verb they urge (تحضيض) and open none.

masdar._words_comment: الموصولات الحرفية: each joins the sentence after it into one masdar (بتأويل المصدر). ما only when facts.ma_kind finds no عائد (else it is the relative and its صلة); `named_by_word` names the particle for its own kind.
masdar._after_preposition_comment: إلى أن تنجحوا، لكي أدخل، بما ترك: hung on a حرف جر, the masdar is its مجرور whatever relation the parser gives it.
masdar.label: مَصْدَرٌ مُؤَوَّلٌ
masdar._after_family_comment: A masdar unit hung on one of these particles, with a noun before it, does this job in this case instead (Tasheel 3.2 p67: the excepted is not of the group).

frames._command_comment: `command`: a verb that gives an order is named for it in the picture: `verb` for a command (اكتبْ), and a present verb under a jazm particle whose card has `verb_as` for it (لِيَكتبْ, لا تأكلْ).
frames._passive_comment: `passive`: a verb built for the unknown doer is named so on its card and in the picture (ضُرِبَ، أُمِرْتُ), its role still the فعل.
frames._sentence_by_family_comment: The term (tarkeeb.json) a whole sentence is called when a word in it is read as one of these families (ما أحسن زيدًا: جملة إنشائية تعجبية).
frames._unit_by_family_comment: `unit_by_family`: the term (tarkeeb.json) a unit headed by a particle of this family is called (إلا الله in لا إله إلا الله is an استثناء; لا with its noun a جملة اسمية). `unit_less`: a particle family that heads no unit (a وَ joining two sentences stands beside the one it brings). `said_clause`: the sentence a verb of saying hangs as its object is its مقول القول, in the place of nasb.

exception_after_la._comment: لا إله إلا الله, as Ibn Hishām parses it (رسالة في إعراب لا إله إلا الله; مغني اللبيب): the khabar of لا is left out because it is known, and it sits between the noun and إلا, since the name after إلا stands in for the pronoun hidden in it. `by_noun`: for an اسم لا with no khabar and إلا after it, the khabar no one writes (`khabar`, drawn hidden under its own name, `khabar_named`), and what the noun after إلا is said to be (`badal`), the stronger view first and the most transmitted one after it. Kept to the nouns listed: the تقدير is chosen for the meaning (بحق, not موجود), so it is not guessed for another noun.

إله.badal: بدل من الضمير المستتر في الخبر المحذوف (مَعْبُودٌ بِحَقٍّ)، وقيل: من محل «لا» مع اسمها

frames._clause_after_noun_comment: A sentence hung on a noun describes it: after an indefinite noun it is its صفة, in the noun's own case; after a definite one, or after the verb whose definite doer or object it follows, its حال, in the place of nasb (الجمل بعد النكرات صفات وبعد المعارف أحوال).

clause_after_noun._owner_comment: `owner`: a حال is said of its صاحب (جملة عز وجل في محل نصب حال من لفظ الجلالة), the noun it stands beside in the picture.
clause_after_noun._on_khabar_comment: `on_khabar`: after an indefinite khabar that is itself a describing word (إن الله جميلٌ يحب الجمال), the sentence describes no noun: it is a second khabar of the same subject, in that khabar's job and case.

frames._on_the_verb_comment: `on_the_verb`: roles whose noun the parser may hang, with its و, on the noun before it like a معطوف (جاء الأميرُ والجيشَ), while the verb is what governs it: in the picture the و and the noun hang on that verb.
frames._clause_after_waw_comment: A nominal sentence a و brings after a verb's sentence (دخل المديرُ وهو مبتسمٌ، جاء زيدٌ والشمسُ طالعةٌ) tells the state the doer was in: it is a `job` in the place of `case`, its و `waw`.
frames._two_objects_comment: A verb of ظن or of giving (`families`) takes two objects: in the picture the first is named `names[0]`, the second `names[1]` (ظننتُ المعلمَ حاضرًا), both the card's `role`.
frames._understood_comment: `understood`: a jar-majroor or ظرف (`slot`, by role) standing in a khabar slot (الحمد لله، زيد في الدار) is متعلق to a word no one writes, `word`, which is the khabar. `khabar_of`: the khabar each subject role takes.

understood._voweled_comment: `voweled`: the word as drawn, its letters voweled to the case; the case is its place, the one its subject's clause stands in (roles `clause_of`: ثَابِتٌ for a مبتدأ or اسم إن, ثَابِتًا for اسم كان), worn as the tanween an indefinite noun takes in it (`tanween`).
understood._fronted_comment: `fronted`: when the unwritten khabar comes before a مبتدأ (في البيت رجلٌ), each is named for its place: خبر مقدم، مبتدأ مؤخر.

verb._comment: A منصوب noun that heads its own sentence and no word governs (أهلًا وسهلًا، شكرًا لك) is the object of a verb no one writes: `word` is it, `noun` what the noun is, a مفعول مطلق when it is a masdar.
verb._reply_comment: A bare noun a verb of saying (`said_clause`) hangs, in a text with a question before it whose question word stands for an object (ماذا فرض الله ... فقال الصلواتِ), is the answer: the object of the question's verb, which is left unsaid. That verb is drawn as a hidden word of its own, named `word`, over the answer; `detail` is what the answer's unit is said to be.

doer._comment: The doer every verb has (Tasheel: الضمير المستتر والمتصل). Read when no word of the sentence is its doer: `pronoun` by person, gender and number as CAMeL tags them (person 1 has no gender); `hidden` the ones each tense keeps unseen inside the verb, by aspect (p past, i present, c command), every other one is written onto the verb. `by_family` the name a family gives it; a passive verb's is نائب فاعل, any other's فاعل. `explicit`: roles a word holds when the doer is written out.
doer._reply_comment: `reply_to`: a verb inside the answer to a question (see understood.verb.reply) is said to the one who asked, so a تـ verb with nothing else to settle it is أنتَ.

hidden_said_by_family.wonder: ضمير مستتر وجوبًا تقديره {pronoun} يعود على ما

doer._person_comment: `command`: a command whose reading lost its person is said to one man (اقبلْ); a person on its suffix comes tagged. `ta_prefix`: a singular present verb opening with تـ is you or she by its letters (تكتبُ); the subject a khabar's pronoun goes back to settles it, else both are said, joined by `either`.
doer._prefix_comment: حروف المضارعة (أنيت) name a present verb's person: `prefix_says` the letters that settle it whole (أَكْتُبُ أنا، نَكْتُبُ نحن, the hamza often left off), `prefix_person` the persons each letter allows. A reading whose person the letter does not allow (لَأَكْتُبَنَّ taken for the نون of women) leaves the doer unsaid.
